limits: This small JavaScript pilot is diagnostic. Each held-out series has one recurrence task, so the default 4 repeats give 8 recurrence observations per arm, below the 30 the promotion rule requires; 15 repeats on the held-out split is only a floor, because unscored recurrence tasks reduce the count. With 32 held-out attempts, one attempt is about 3 percentage points, so the 2-point non-inferiority margin tolerates no additional failure. Results apply to the model and runtime that produced them. Auto-routed models, dry runs and scripted runs never qualify for promotion.
